decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: decodeTypeWithCodeFlags' decoder cursor is mutated across the throw (element stays open, attributes consumed, children unread) — observed via peek + close + sibling open on the SAME decoder (marshal.cc:126-241: getNextAttributeId never restarts without rewindAttributes, closeElementSkipping pops without a child check); TypeCode::decodePrototype's factory&/voidtype feed the (unreached) proto construction; setPrototype(fp,newCode,flags) mutates the container entry in place (Rust replaces both Arc channels — factory-mediated view equivalent, stale external handles are the registered immutable-Arc residual).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: decodeBasic's attribute for(;;) runs the index to exhaustion before any caller loop re-reads (type.cc:629-670); the WORDSIZE loop at type.cc:4201-4207 follows WITHOUT rewindAttributes, so with XmlDecode/TreeDecoder it reads nothing — wordsize stays the TypePointer ctor default 1; decodeCode's decodeStub then re-enumerates the same exhausted element and hits the size<0 throw at type.cc:671; the struct/union/code arms of resolveIncompleteTypedefs walk the incompleteTypedef list front-to-back with erase-advance (type.cc:3780-3808).
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: no counters in this family; the only accumulating state is the incompleteTypedef list (appended by getTypedef type.cc:3837-3838 only when the clone is type_incomplete, drained by resolveIncompleteTypedefs on referenced-type completion).
